verdict.rationale: Belvo's own docs say its aggregation product retrieves account balances and supports asynchronous real-time POST calls. Its Smart Collections product watches a user's balance against conditions and notifies you when there are enough funds to collect, which covers the NSF-avoidance intent. However, no specific balance endpoint is documented, and it is not described as a synchronous pre-payment NSF/risk check. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented balance endpoint with request/response details, evidence that balances are live rather than cached, explicit NSF/risk-check guidance for the pre-payment flow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can fetch a real-time balance for a connected account before initiating a payment — a documented balance endpoint intended for NSF and risk checks

citations.quote: Retrieve transaction history, account balances, and investment details seamlessly.
Asynchronous real-time POST calls (both single and recurrent links)
Belvo monitors your user's balance and notifies you the moment there are enough funds to collect.
you tell Belvo the amounts you want to collect as well as the balance conditions to wait for and Belvo watches the account in the background
